capabilities: Organize notes with parent, child, sibling and jump relationships
Edit folders and note content from the graph
Switch between mind map, native graph and 3D knowledge world views
Activate an offline license purchased via WeChat
extras: All features are gated behind a ¥99 one-time license activated manually through a WeChat QR code and a seller-issued code; the plugin is desktop-only, not yet listed in the community store, and the README warns to back up the vault before structural editing.
intentEvidence: Disable obsidian-brain first. Back up its data.json, install themind, and copy the backed-up data.json
problem: Obsidian's graph view only displays existing links passively and gives no way to organize notes or edit folder structure through explicit relationships.

relations.evidence: TheMind was previously developed as Mybrain. Offline license tokens retain the internal product identifier mybrain

summary: Paid relationship-graph plugin that organizes notes by parent, child, sibling and jump links, with mind map, native graph and 3D world views.
